name: Kayla Brooks

five_sec.what_is_it: It plans your dinners and puts the groceries in your Walmart cart 🛒
five_sec.who_for: Moms who can't figure out supper
five_sec.trust_why: It says Walmart and no card right there. Never heard of it but it looks clean
five_sec.delivers_food_why: It says 'We don't deliver food.' It just fills your cart

full_page.what_stopped_me: Nothin really. I wasn't sure if Tyler gets the plan on his phone on the free one or if that's the $4.99 part
full_page.whats_missing: Cheap stuff with what's actually at my Walmart. How my husband sees the plan without paying

DD.quote: Y'all it said Walmart AND free AND no card 😭 and that sample week was $64 for all five dinners. I can do that.

five_sec.delivers_food_why: It's just an app with a notebook picture

full_page.what_stopped_me: I have to save my own recipes and plan it all myself. And it's $5.95 after
full_page.whats_missing: Something that just tells me what to cook

PTE.quote: Save, organize, plan, shop... that's a lotta app 😅 I can't even think of what to cook, I sure don't have recipes to save

five_sec.what_is_it: HelloFresh, the food in a box
five_sec.who_for: People with more money than us
five_sec.trust_why: Open a box game is kinda fun ngl but it's a trick to get you
five_sec.delivers_food_why: The green boxes. They send you the food

full_page.what_stopped_me: The tiny print says the 10 free meals is for the big 5-recipe family plan and then it charges every week. Price is behind a zip code
full_page.whats_missing: A price. Something I could afford on $120 a week

HF.quote: I almost tapped a box 🎁 but the '10 free meals' is only on the big 4-person plan and then it renews every week. Our grocery money is $120.

five_sec.what_is_it: Meal plans I think? Mama and a little girl in a video
five_sec.trust_why: Looks like it's been around a while
five_sec.delivers_food_why: Cartoon of a phone with food around it

full_page.what_stopped_me: Never found the price, and a pop-up wanted my email first. Some of the food is fancy
full_page.whats_missing: The price. Whether they want my card

EM.quote: Walmart's the first logo and there's a Budget Friendly plan 🙌 but Shrimp Po' Boys and steak with bok choy?? And I never found the price

five_sec.what_is_it: An app that picks out meals for you
five_sec.trust_why: 90,000 families and it looks real cute. But the button's a letter from the CEO?
five_sec.delivers_food_why: Pictures of food on the phone, can't tell if they send it

full_page.what_stopped_me: $25 a month! The free one is only 50 messages a month

OL.quote: It looks so cute and it does Walmart, but $25 a month?! The free one gives you 50 messages a month, I'd run outta those quick

dd_offer.why: It says free, no card, and after 14 days it's $4.99 if you want to keep it or you just keep the free one
dd_offer.expect_day_15: The texting the family part stops unless I pay, but I still get my free dinners and my Walmart cart. They can't charge me, they don't have my card

head_to_head.reason: Free, no card, and it goes right in my Walmart cart for pickup

PTE.reason: It tells me what to cook instead of me doing it

HF.reason: I can't afford boxes, I can afford Walmart

EM.reason: It's free and shows the price; eMeals never did

dd_fix_that_would_move_me: Home page, near 'Start free': say how my husband sees the week on the free plan (like a link I can text him), not only in the Family plan, and show a cheap Walmart week for a family with toddlers
